events.headline: OIL SHOCK TRIGGERS GLOBAL PRICE SPIKES AS IRAN WAR DRAGS ON
events.detail: Fuel shocks from the US-Israel war on Iran are rippling worldwide, as Strait of Hormuz disruptions push prices higher.

events.headline: RUSSIA SENDING SECOND SHIP WITH OIL TO CUBA AMID US BLOCKADE
events.detail: Announcement comes days after Russian tanker brought some 700,000 barrels of crude to Cuba in response to energy crisis.

events.headline: ANDRÉS REPETTO, ANALISTA INTERNACIONAL: “ESTAMOS AL BORDE DEL ABISMO”
events.detail: En diálogo con LN+, el especialista detalló el cambio en la táctica militar del régimen iraní y el control sobre el estrecho de Ormuz; la advertencia de Donald Trump y el posible despliegue de tropas

events.headline: GCC CHIEF URGES UN TO HALT IRANIAN ATTACKS, PROTECT GULF WATERWAYS
events.detail: Jassim al-Budaiwi calls on UN Security Council to guarantee 'uninterrupted navigation through all strategic waterways'.

events.headline: CAN RUSSIA HELP FILL THE GLOBAL ENERGY GAP?
events.detail: Higher crude prices due to the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz have helped Russia earn more from energy exports.

events.headline: EL REINO UNIDO REÚNE AL MARGEN DE TRUMP A 40 PAÍSES PARA IMPULSAR LA REAPERTURA
events.detail: Unos 2.000 buques mercantes y cerca de 20.000 marineros permanecen atrapados por el bloqueo de Irán
